messages:
rachel_devex: Quick report — found an async-only replay bug where a 502 + local timeout leads to a replay that drops Authorization and Idempotency-Key. Caused duplicate creates in a pilot.

omar_sdk: which sdk version and retry settings?

rachel_devex: python-sdk 1.0.3, AsyncClient default retry (exp jitter), per-call timeout 1.2s. Minimal repro below.

rachel_devex: ```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key="sk-test-zz", timeout=1.2)
    await c.post("/v1/resources", json={"name":"r1"}, headers={"Idempotency-Key":"key-42"})

asyncio.run(main())
```

lee_infra: logs snippet:

```
-> POST /v1/resources
-> Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-test-zz, Idempotency-Key: key-42
<- 502 Bad Gateway
ClientTimeout after 1.2s (cancelled)
Scheduling retry attempt=2
-> POST /v1/resources
-> Headers: Idempotency-Key: key-42
<- 201 Created
```

rachel_devex: second attempt missing Authorization so backend accepted it as unauthenticated create and inserted a duplicate.

omar_sdk: reproducible. Root cause: retry reconstruction uses saved per-call headers but the auth middleware supplies Authorization later and its state isn't reapplied on replay. Timeout/cancel path also clears plugin state.

janet_pm: customer impact? severity?

rachel_devex: pilot customer saw duplicates, marking P1. Mitigation: set client.session.headers["Authorization"] at init or disable auto-retries for non-idempotent endpoints. Both are suboptimal.

omar_sdk: Plan: 1) preserve middleware-auth headers when building replay requests OR re-run auth middleware on replay, 2) add a guard so a local timeout only enqueues a retry if transport signaled a retriable error, 3) add idempotency_key helper param on high-level helpers that auto-sets header. Will add unit+integration tests (simulate 502+timeout) and a changelog.

bot-ci: Created branch fix/replay-auth-2256 and attached CI reproducer.achel_devex: I added the tiny repro and curl traces to the issue and PR. Thanks! :thumbsup:
